issue_context.title: System.Text.Json GetConverterFromAttribute need to be annotated for native aot
issue_context.body:
The above method in `JsonSerializerOptions `has a suppression currently until converter code that calls this method is refactored to distinguish between reflection and source generated paths. The suppression is there so as to make forward progress on the effort to annotate this library and get the PR #68464 merged but it is dangerous since some reflection code paths will go through this method. 

The [conversation](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/68464#discussion_r861878209) in the PR has more details.

review_comments: I agree they should be behind contract resolver but I do not agree that IJsonTypeInfo would have to become abstract. Currently source gen stores converters on JsonTypeInfos and we could do the same for reflection
btw is this ok we keep looping below even though we already found converter here?
I think might be better idea to move this call into ReadFromSpan (wherever JsonTypeInfo is configured)
Perhaps I'm missing something but assuming GetConverterForTypeSourceGen is linker safe, why can't we just call it directly? Shouldn't reflection path be hidden under the callback?
this is not needed considering constructors are already annotated. better if we suppress this
I think in the other code path (my first comment about this) this gets double initialized since you already do that here
I don't see what guarantees this... should this be using reflection path here as fallback?
I think this should be called when JsonTypeInfo is configured
This is a static variable that can be initialized to two different values. Is it thread safe? What prevents two different from taking the two different initialization paths in parallel?
It might make sense to only populate this static with the reflection-based factory, and only set or consult the value when `_serializerContext` is set to null.
